beats.say: Russia is bigger than the entire surface of Pluto.
beats.title: RUSSIA IS BIGGER THAN PLUTO

beats.say: Russia covers seventeen point one million square kilometers. Pluto's whole surface is about sixteen point seven.
It stretches across eleven time zones.
When it's eight in the morning in Kaliningrad, it's already six in the evening in Kamchatka.
But most of that land is empty. About three quarters of Russians live west of the Ural Mountains, in the European part.
East of that line: Siberia. One of the emptiest places on the planet.
Bigger than a planet, emptier than a desert. Follow for more.
beats.title: BIGGER THAN A PLANET
